in_sanskrit.name: Sharav
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharav is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'shara', which means 'king' or 'ruler'. The prefix 'va' denotes 'forest' or 'woods'. So, Sharav means 'King of the Forest'.

in_hindi.name: Sharwansh
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Sharwansh is a modern name and its meaning is not definitively known. It is believed to be a combination of the names Sharav and Ansh, which have the meanings 'King of the Forest' and 'Boundless' respectively. However, there is no definitive proof of this origin and it is purely speculative.
